title: payload: effect_confirmed
description: AgentMeasure Effect Confirmation: a determination that an Effect has occurred and is attested, with evidence grade, stability window, and reversal chain. Draft 0.4.4.

effect_id.description: Canonical identity for this effect confirmation. Immutable after first emission (append-only ledger).

operation_id.description: The operation whose execution produced this effect.

task_id.description: Optional: the task this effect relates to, when tracked at task grain.

outcome_class.description: Low-cardinality outcome classification. Must be drawn from the registry vocabularies.yaml single source of truth. assumed_resolved MUST NOT be aggregated into resolved (invariant 16).

observer_grade.description: Who attests this effect occurred and has the stated outcome_class. Ascending trust: self_attested < affected_party < third_party_corroborated.

stability_window_seconds.description: How long this confirmation must survive without reversal before it is settlement-grade. Default 259200 (72 hours); vertical profiles may override.

confirmed_at.description: Timestamp when this confirmation was produced (not when the effect occurred).

stability_deadline.description: Confirmed_at + stability_window_seconds. Before this time, the confirmation is preliminary and may be reversed.

external_ids.description: External evidence references (ticket system status change, human reply, automated verification hook).

reversal_of.description: If this confirmation reverses a previous effect (e.g. reopened after resolved), the effect_id of the reversed confirmation. reversal_of MUST chain to an existing effect_confirmed record — silent deletion is forbidden.

supersedes.description: If this confirmation corrects an earlier confirmation for the same effect (not a reversal of outcome_class, but a correction of metadata), the effect_id being superseded.

incrementality_evidence.description: Evidence level supporting an incrementality claim for this effect. When this effect is billed on billing_basis=outcome, this field is REQUIRED (see COMMERCIAL §5). none = no incrementality evidence → billing defaults to operation basis.
